> missing..."
>
> It appears like this is no longer true (the manual lists the poisson cdf).

Yep. However, it doesn't have a full complement of distribution related functions for exponentiated arguments.
poisson_log_log exists but
poisson_ccdf_log_log does not (I just tried it, even though it was not in the manual. Maybe it should be
poisson_log_ccdf_log..

Similarly, no poisson_log_cdf_log.

I'm not saying there should be, though it would have been handy for me if there were :)

Ross

We'll eventually get around to adding all the cumulative
distribution functions. We could just wrap them inefficiently
for now and expand to better floating-point behavior and faster
gradients later. That would at least allow the truncated models
to work normally.

And I'll patch the manual to make it correct for poisson. Thanks.

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/292
